# Bicycle London

> Bicycle is an independent, integrated media and creative agency in Clerkenwell, London, built on "the power of and". Founded in 2021, B Corp certified, 100% independent with no external investment. Services span media planning and buying, performance, creative, influencer and social, and international media.

## Core pages
- [About](https://www.bicyclelondon.com/about): How Bicycle started and what it believes.
- [Purpose](https://www.bicyclelondon.com/purpose): B Corp certification and the XO Bikes partnership.
- [The Peloton](https://www.bicyclelondon.com/the-peloton): The team behind Bicycle.
- [Contact](https://www.bicyclelondon.com/contact-us): New business, general and careers enquiries.

## What we do
- [Bicycle](https://www.bicyclelondon.com/bicycle): The integrated media ecosystem.
- [Blade](https://www.bicyclelondon.com/bicycle-blade): Performance consultancy.
- [Studio](https://www.bicyclelondon.com/bicycle-studio): Creative studio, brand to performance.
- [Ripple](https://www.bicyclelondon.com/bicycle-ripple): Influencer and social.
- [International](https://www.bicyclelondon.com/international): Independent international media.
